October 22, 2026

#### GHSL-2026-229: Arbitrary code execution on pull requests in a privileged reusable release-check.yml workflow from ipdxco/unified-github-workflows - CVE-2026-92261

The ipdxco/unified-github-workflows release-check.yml allows pull request-controlled version data to inject commands into a privileged workflow.

Peter Stöckli

October 22, 2026

#### GHSL-2026-151: Crafted search links can execute JavaScript on mkdocs-material sites - CVE-2026-73295

mkdocs-material's search suggestion allowed crafted links to execute JavaScript in the origin of documentation sites that enable the feature.

Peter Stöckli

October 1, 2026

#### GHSL-2026-109: Local apps can steal location data and write files through OsmAnd - CVE-2026-65995

OsmAnd's exported AIDL service automatically authorizes callers, allowing zero-permission applications to steal real-time location data and write or delete files.

Kevin Stubbings

October 1, 2026

#### GHSL-2026-108: Local apps can silently import malicious settings into OsmAnd - CVE-2026-65997

A zero-permission application can send privileged intent extras to OsmAnd's exported MapActivity and silently import attacker-controlled OSF settings.

Kevin Stubbings

October 1, 2026

#### GHSL-2026-106: Malicious deep links enable arbitrary file writes in OsmAnd - CVE-2026-65996

A remote attacker can exploit path traversal in the OsmAnd `/open-gpx` deep link to fetch arbitrary URLs and write attacker-controlled GPX files within the app's scoped storage.

Kevin Stubbings

October 1, 2026

#### GHSL-2026-103: Local apps can hijack Wikipedia Android WebViews and steal session cookies - CVE-2026-65994

A local application can invoke an exported Wikipedia Android activity to load an attacker-controlled webpage, steal session cookies, and expose personal information.

Kevin Stubbings

October 1, 2026

#### GHSL-2026-101: Malicious deep links can steal Wikipedia Android session cookies - CVE-2026-65993

Improper host validation in the Wikipedia Android app deep-link handler allows attackers to load malicious content, steal session cookies, and compromise user accounts.

#### GHSL-2025-078: Untrusted pull request code execution in the nf-core/tools snapshot workflow

The nf-core/tools update-textual-snapshots workflow could execute untrusted pull request code in a privileged GitHub Actions context.

#### GHSL-2026-124_GHSL-2026-134: Memory corruption, information disclosure, and denial of service in NanaZip - CVE-2026-54616, CVE-2026-44215, CVE-2026-47222, CVE-2026-47223, CVE-2026-42446, CVE-2026-47224, CVE-2026-42442, CVE-2026-42443, CVE-2026-42445, CVE-2026-42355, CVE-2026-42444

NanaZip contains memory-safety, parsing, and resource-exhaustion vulnerabilities that can cause memory corruption, information disclosure, or denial of service.

The API Diff Check workflow invokes a pull request-controlled local action in a privileged pull_request_target job. An external contributor can execute arbitrary code with a write-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN and access the ORG_REPO_TOKEN secret.

Jaroslav Lobačevski

August 8, 2026

#### GHSL-2026-152: Privilege escalation via authorization bypass in graphql-ruby

GraphQL::Schema::Resolver#call (used by the Execution::Next Runner) catches GraphQL::UnauthorizedError from a resolver's authorized? hook and incorrectly sets is_authed = true, causing resolve to run and its data to be returned to the client despite the authorization failure. This bypasses the library's documented raise UnauthorizedError authorization pattern for any schema using Execution::Next.

Bas Alberts

August 8, 2026

#### GHSL-2025-115: Insecure deserialization in NVTabular could lead to RCE - CVE-2025-33214

NVTabular v23.08.00 is affected by an insecure deserialization vulnerability in the Workflow.load method, which could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

Sylwia Budzynska

August 8, 2026

#### GHSL-2025-113: Insecure deserialization in NVIDIA-Merlin/Transformers4Rec could lead to RCE - CVE-2025-33213

NVIDIA-Merlin/Transformers4Rec v23.12.00 is affected by insecure deserialization in the load_model_trainer_states_from_checkpoint function, which could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code when loading malicious models.

Sylwia Budzynska

August 8, 2026

#### GHSL-2024-200_GHSL-2024-201: Zero click RCE in Uptrain - CVE-2025-27771, CVE-2025-27772

The Uptrain dashboard lacks significant authentication, has an open CORS policy, and is vulnerable to a remote code execution vulnerability. Combining these primitives, an attacker can get zero click remote code execution in the context of the Uptrain host by directing an Uptrain user to a specially crafted website.

Kevin Stubbings

August 8, 2026

#### GHSL-2026-140: Heap Buffer Write Overflow in 7-Zip

A heap buffer overflow vulnerability (GHSL-2026-140) exists in 7-Zip version 26.00, caused by an under-allocation in the NTFS compressed stream buffer (GetCuSize shift UB), potentially allowing attackers to exploit this issue for arbitrary code execution.
